sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – proposal for a fixed-price arrangement from 2027-01-01
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for taking the time to discuss our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels, and we appreciate the effort your team puts into reviewing a longer-term arrangement with us.

Would you kindly consider a fixed price of EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net and a 36-month contract? Our annual requirement is 23,700 kg, with DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges. We hope the prompt payment and longer commitment make this a useful package for your business as well.

For context, our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognize that these earlier purchases do not tell the whole story of your costs today, and we understand that this is a substantial request. We hope our EUR 4.60/kg proposal provides a useful starting point for reviewing the package together. We would be grateful if you could review it with the colleague responsible for pricing and let us know whether you can offer these terms as your binding proposal.

Thank you again for considering this. We would be very pleased to reach an agreement together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract and 14-day payment terms, which we are pleased to incorporate into our offer. However, for a long-term agreement of 36 months, we cannot offer a fixed price and must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material cost fluctuations. Taking into account the historical purchase orders you cited, we can reduce our offer to EUR 5.40 per kg under these revised terms. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We can also present the following package: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – revised proposal: 24-month fixed price
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you very much for reviewing our proposal so quickly, and for the meaningful step you have taken on price. We also appreciate your clear explanation that a fixed price over 36 months is difficult because of material cost fluctuations.

We understand that concern and would like to meet you on it. Could your team consider a shorter, fixed-price arrangement instead?

- Unit price: EUR 4.72/kg, fixed for the full term
- Contract term: 24 months
- Payment: 14 days net
- No price adjustment clause
- 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling charges

The shorter term reduces how long your price is exposed. For us, a fixed price remains important for planning, and we hope the prompt payment helps as well.

If this package still does not work, it would help us to understand whether the main obstacle is the unit price, the fixed-price term itself, or internal approval. We would be grateful if you could let us know whether you can issue these terms as a binding offer.

Thank you again for your time and constructive approach.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your flexibility in proposing a 24-month contract, which we are pleased to accept alongside the 14-day payment terms. To address your question, the primary obstacle is the fixed-price term itself; due to raw material volatility, the AS-14404 index clause remains essential for any multi-year agreement. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Incorporating this index clause, we can reduce our offer to EUR 5.20 per kg. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Our current proposal stands at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price proposal for 24 months
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your reply, for accepting the 24-month term and 14-day payment, and for explaining so clearly that the fixed price itself is the main obstacle. We understand why material volatility matters to you, and we appreciate your openness about it.

For our planning, a fixed price remains essential, so we are unfortunately not able to include a price adjustment clause. To help balance that risk on your side, we have moved our price again:

- Unit price: EUR 4.83/kg, fixed for the full term
- Contract term: 24 months
- Payment: 14 days net
- No price adjustment clause
- 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling charges

Material prices have also moved in both directions recently: AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

Would you kindly review this fixed package with the colleague responsible for pricing? If this price is not possible, it would help us greatly to know which fixed price within this same package you could consider as a binding offer.

Thank you again for your time and constructive approach.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
